headline: Yantra Energetics files SEBI Takeover disclosure for RattanIndia Enterprises
sum: Yantra Energetics Private Limited has filed a Regulation 31(4) disclosure under the SEBI Takeover Code, signalling a substantial acquisition of shares and/or an open offer intention in RattanIndia Enterprises Limited (NSE: RTNINDIA).
detail: Yantra Energetics Private Limited submitted a statutory disclosure to NSE under SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011, Regulation 31(4), on 30 June 2026. The disclosure was published on NSE archives on 6 July 2026. Regulation 31(4) requires an acquirer to disclose to the stock exchange within 2 calendar days of crossing the 25% threshold in equity shareholding of a listed company. The filing does not specify the precise shareholding percentage, consideration value, or structure (whether open offer or scheme). RattanIndia Enterprises is a publicly listed entity engaged in energy and infrastructure sectors.
